summary: @yeaft/webchat-agent pipes remote WebSocket bytes into a local PTY, exposing full-host command execution
details: When the agent bin is started, it opens a WebSocket connection to a configurable server (default ws://localhost:3456) and dispatches server-sent messages to a PTY handler. On `terminal_create` the agent spawns a bash/pwsh/cmd PTY via `pty.spawn(shell,...)`, and on `terminal_input` it writes the remote peer's bytes directly into that PTY with `term.pty.write(msg.data)`. Whoever controls the configured WebSocket endpoint (or anyone who can reach it and pass the shared `agentSecret`) obtains an interactive shell on the host running the agent, with the privileges of the invoking user. The agent additionally, at startup, runs `git clone https://github.com/yeaft/yeaft-skills.git` (or `git pull --ff-only`) into `~/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/yeaft-skills-dev` without pinning to a commit, and registers/enables that plugin in Claude Code's `known_marketplaces.json`, `installed_plugins.json`, and `settings.json`; future changes to the upstream branch flow into the installer's Claude Code plugin set on each start.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
